literal_meaning: চিত্রগুপ্তের খাতা (Chitragupta's ledger or account book)
figurative_meaning_bn: মানুষের কৃত-কর্মের হিসাব-নিকাশের খাতা; মানুষের পাপপুণ্যের নির্ভূল হিসাব; সবকিছু যমের নজরে আছে
figurative_meaning_en: A ledger recording human deeds and actions; an infallible account of people's sins and virtues; everything is under Yama's scrutiny
example_sentences_in_bangla: তোমার সব ভালো-মন্দ কাজ চিত্রগুপ্তের খাতায় লেখা আছে।
জীবনে যা করছ, সব চিত্রগুপ্তের খাতায় হিসাব হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: All your good and bad deeds are recorded in Chitragupta's ledger.
Whatever you do in life will be accounted for in Chitragupta's book.
history: Chitragupta is a Hindu deity depicted as the divine scribe and assistant to Yama, the god of death, who maintains a precise record of every person's actions, sins, and virtues to determine their fate after death.
note: This idiom draws from Hindu Puranic traditions and is commonly used to remind people of accountability for their actions.
